title: The test suite is red
prompts: `npm test` is failing in this repo after a recent change. Fix the code so the whole suite passes again. Do not edit, skip or delete any tests.
notes: Three regressions across dates.js (Sunday counted as a business day, holiday compare against a full ISO string), tax.js (floor instead of round in splitInclusive) and discount.js (fixed discount no longer clamps). Six visible tests fail. Grading replaces test/ with the original suite plus extra cases, so editing tests cannot pass.
